name: agora-vai
description: Orchestrator for Save State (Next.js) + ATP Engine — runs both via a single pnpm command

scripts.dev:concurrently: concurrently --kill-others --names "ATP,SAVE" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "pnpm --filter atp-engine dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000/health --timeout 120000 --interval 1000 --verbose && PORT=3001 pnpm --filter save-state dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter atp-engine build && pnpm --filter save-state build
